seo.title: ReportAI — From audio to report, without touching a template

cta.becomeClient: I want to become a client

hero.headlineLine2: Get the minutes back in your own template.
hero.subheadline: ReportAI transcribes the meeting, fills in the exact document your company already uses, and sends it to the right person — over Telegram, the default channel, or whichever one you already use. No joining video calls, no generic templates, no installs.

fields.summaryValue: Quarterly order review and delivery terms.

howItWorks.heading: From voice note to delivered minutes.

record.title: Record a voice note
record.body: In the car, in the hallway, right after hanging up. Over Telegram, the default channel, or whichever one you already use.

transcribe.title: It gets transcribed
transcribe.body: The AI converts the audio into text in seconds.

extract.title: The data gets extracted
extract.body: It identifies date, attendees, summary, and agreements based on your document's exact fields.

approve.title: You approve it
approve.body: You review the draft and confirm, or request a quick correction.

deliver.title: It gets delivered
deliver.body: The document is filled into your .docx template and reaches the right person.

approval.heading: Nothing goes out without your approval.
approval.paragraph1: Every report goes through mandatory human review before it's delivered. If something's off, you correct it with a simple reply and ReportAI tries again.
approval.paragraph2: By default, everything goes through Telegram. If your team uses another channel, we adapt it with you during onboarding — every setup is custom-built.
approval.otherChannelNote: + whichever channel you already use, if you prefer

differentiator.heading: It's not a bot that sneaks into your video call.
differentiator.paragraph: Otter, Fireflies, or Fathom need a scheduled video call with a link. Most of your sales visits and calls don't have one. ReportAI works from a voice note recorded afterward — in the car, in the hallway, right after hanging up — and turns it into the document with the exact format your company already uses.
differentiator.kicker: None of this is needed. Just a voice note.

templateFidelity.heading: Your template, not ours.
templateFidelity.paragraph: You upload the .docx your company already uses. ReportAI fills in those same fields, in that same format — no generic PDF with your logo pasted on top.

realDemo.heading: This isn't a mockup.
realDemo.paragraph: It's the system's real output: an actual voice note, transcribed, extracted, and filled into your template by the AI — unedited afterward. Hit play.
realDemo.playPlaceholder: Hit play to see the real transcript appear here.

finalCta.headline: Send a voice note. Get the minutes.
finalCta.sub: You've already seen a real example above. The next one could come from your template.
